Senior Software Engineer - TechCorp
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Type: Full-time
Department: Engineering

About the Role

TechCorp is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing platform team in Amsterdam. You will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining the backend services and cloud infrastructure that power our data analytics platform, used by over 2 million users worldwide. This is an opportunity to work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment alongside talented engineers who are passionate about delivering high-quality software at scale.

Requirements

- 5+ years of professional software development experience
- Strong proficiency in Python, with experience building production-grade REST APIs using frameworks such as Django or FastAPI
- Solid understanding of cloud services on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, SQS)
- Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization and local development workflows
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI
- Experience with front-end development using React and TypeScript
- Strong knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
- Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows including code reviews and pull requests
- Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
- Good communication skills in English; Dutch is a plus

Nice to Have

- Experience with container orchestration using Kubernetes
- Familiarity with GraphQL APIs and schema design
- Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
- Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana
- Contributions to open-source projects

Responsibilities

- Design and implement scalable microservices and APIs that handle millions of requests per day
- Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define and deliver new features
- Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code following engineering best practices
- Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews
- Mentor junior developers and contribute to a culture of continuous learning
- Improve and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure fast and reliable deployments
- Monitor production systems and respond to incidents as part of an on-call rotation

Benefits

- Competitive salary and equity package
- 30 days of paid vacation
- Flexible hybrid work model
- Annual learning and development budget
- Relocation assistance for international candidates

To apply, send your CV and a brief cover letter to careers@techcorp.example.com.
